new_value: Refuted at HEAD; closed with evidence and hardening tests. RFC 6550 Section 7.2 rule 3.1.1: cross-region counters with (256 + B - A) <= SEQUENCE_WINDOW(16) means B is newer - INCLUSIVE boundary, with the RFC's own worked examples (21 -> A newer, 11 -> B newer). Rule 3.2.1: same-region |diff| <= SEQUENCE_WINDOW is comparable (RFC 1982); > 16 incomparable. The existing lollipop_cmp implements exactly this: diff <= 16 in both regions, wrap_distance <= 16 cross-region. The bead's suggested '< 16' would violate the RFC's MUST and break three pinned test vectors ((16,0,Greater), (255,239,Greater), (0,240,Greater)). Hardening added: doc comment on lollipop_cmp citing RFC 6550 section 7.2 with inclusive-boundary semantics, plus test lollipop_sequence_window_boundaries_are_inclusive_per_rfc_6550_7_2 covering exactly-16/15/17 in both regions and both cross-region directions. NOTE: discovered the PYTHON reference diverges from the RFC (no window in linear-linear, half-window 128 circular-circular, unconditional linear-newer cross-region) - filed as separate bead.
